note: Imagecache External applies image styles to remote images by caching them locally (core function imagecache_external_generate_path). Consumed via field formatters (imagecache_external_image, imagecache_external_responsive_image), theme hooks (imagecache_external, imagecache_external_responsive), and a Twig filter (|imagecache_external('style')). All settings live in config imagecache_external.settings (keys include imagecache_directory, imagecache_external_use_whitelist, imagecache_external_hosts, imagecache_external_management, imagecache_fallback_image, cron flush keys, svg_settings). Configure route imagecache_external.admin_settings; permission 'administer imagecache external'; three Drush commands (imagecache-external:generate/set-default-image/validate-host); three alter hooks. Medium cases read back a known cache directory and whitelist config; hard cases set the whitelist and the cache directory+management, verified against the live config. Shipped defaults: imagecache_directory=externals, use_whitelist=false, hosts='', management=unmanaged.

evals.prompt: Using the imagecache_external module, how do I apply a Drupal image style (say 'thumbnail') to an image that is hosted on an external URL, directly inside a Twig template?
evals.expected_output: Use the imagecache_external Twig filter: {{ 'https://host/image.jpg'|imagecache_external('thumbnail') }}. It caches the remote image locally and returns the URL of the styled derivative.

evals.prompt: In imagecache_external, which configuration keys restrict the external hosts that images are allowed to be fetched from?
evals.expected_output: Enable imagecache_external_use_whitelist and list the allowed hosts (whitespace-separated) in imagecache_external_hosts (both in imagecache_external.settings). Only URLs whose host matches an entry are fetched.

evals.prompt: I have a link/text field that stores the URL of an image on a remote server. Which imagecache_external field formatter renders it as a styled , and what does it let me choose?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'imagecache_external_image' formatter (settings: an image style imagecache_external_style, and an optional link). For responsive image styles use 'imagecache_external_responsive_image'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, into which directory does imagecache_external cache the external images it fetches? Inspect the live configuration and report the directory value.
evals.expected_output: The directory is ice_probe_ext (under the default scheme, i.e. public://ice_probe_ext): imagecache_external.settings:imagecache_directory (drush cget imagecache_external.settings imagecache_directory).

evals.prompt: Is external-image fetching on this site restricted to specific hosts by imagecache_external? Inspect the live configuration and, if a whitelist is in effect, report which hosts are allowed.
evals.expected_output: Yes — imagecache_external_use_whitelist is true and imagecache_external_hosts is 'example.com trusted.test', so only images from example.com and trusted.test are fetched.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure imagecache_external so that it will only fetch external images from the host cdn.example.org and reject all other hosts. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In imagecache_external.settings set imagecache_external_use_whitelist=TRUE and imagecache_external_hosts='cdn.example.org'. Verified: the whitelist is on and cdn.example.org is in the allowed hosts list.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure imagecache_external to cache fetched external images into a directory named 'ice_cache' and to store them as managed File entities rather than unmanaged files. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In imagecache_external.settings set imagecache_directory='ice_cache' and imagecache_external_management='managed'. Verified: directory === ice_cache and management === managed.
